notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (standard 'User-agent: *  Allow: /' Shopify robots.txt). Confirmed Shopify backend (collections.json/products.json endpoints live). Enumerated the FULL collection taxonomy via /collections.json?limit=250 across 8 pages (1952 collections total, last page returned 202 < 250 confirming end) - this is more exhaustive than the visible nav. Searched all 1952 collection titles/handles for christmas|xmas|halloween|easter|valentine|thanksgiving|diwali|hanukkah|kwanzaa|mother|father|new-year|holiday|seasonal|festive|advent|santa|ornament|wreath|pumpkin|harvest|lunar. Found no dedicated Christmas/Halloween/Easter/Thanksgiving/Diwali/Hanukkah/Kwanzaa collection anywhere; confirmed via internal site search too (christmas=7 incidental product-text hits, easter=4, thanksgiving=1, halloween=0, diwali=0 - none are PLPs, just stray keyword matches in product copy, not proof used alone but consistent with the taxonomy scan). IMPORTANT SITE QUIRK: collections.json's 'products_count' field is unreliable/inflated on this store (matches known Shopify pattern) - e.g. it claimed 32 for valentines-day but the real /products.json enumeration returned only 1; claimed 146 for mothers-day-gifts vs real 45; claimed 57 for fathers-day-design-gifts vs real 10. Verified /products.json pagination is NOT itself capped/broken by cross-checking a large control collection ('furniture'): page 1 alone returned 243 of a claimed 13704, i.e. it scales correctly for big collections, so the small real counts for seasonal collections are genuine, not a pagination artifact. All qty values below are from full /products.json?limit=250 enumeration (paged until an empty page), used because the displayed PLP total is not present in the static HTML (client-hydrated Next.js/RSC page with no exposed count field) and the collections.json count is proven unreliable here. INCLUDED (evaluated under the genuine-PLP test, Mother's/Father's Day explicitly in scope per task rules): 'Mother's Day Gifts' (/collections/mothers-day-gifts, pageType=collection, dedicated non-editorial title, 45 real products) and 'Father's Day Design Gifts' (/collections/fathers-day-design-gifts, pageType=collection, 10 real products) - both are the site's own plainly-named gift category for the occasion. 'Valentine's Day' (/collections/valentines-day, pageType=collection, clean non-editorial title) kept despite only 1 real product (Marcel Wanders Love Sofa) since it is a genuine dedicated node, not a subset/editorial page. EXCLUDED after inspection: 'Mother's Day Staff Picks' (/collections/mothers-day, real qty 2) - a curated staff-picks subset, editorial in nature and redundant with Mother's Day Gifts. 'Earth Day + Mother's Day' (/collections/earth-day-mothers-day, real qty 14) - a hybrid eco/gifting marketing crossover collection, not a clean single-holiday category, redundant with Mother's Day Gifts. 'The Valentine Edit' (/collections/the-valentine-edit, real qty 31) - checked product contents (vases, candlesticks, wine carafes, trays, glassware) which are generic romantic-gifting/entertaining items, not Valentine-specific merchandise; site-wide 'The ___ Edit' naming pattern is used for curated editorial gift collections (confirmed against 'The Holiday Edit' at 6254 claimed products, clearly a whole-catalog marketing hub) - treated as editorial, not genuine taxonomy. The entire 'Holiday: *' family (Holiday: Decor, Bar, Hygge, Kitchen and Dining, Play, Popular, Quick-Ship, Spa, Stocking Stuffers, Work) - verified by pulling actual product handles inside 'Holiday: Decor' (real qty 4): items were a coat hook and a tray, i.e. NOT Christmas decorations at all; this whole family is a gift-guide segmented by room/recipient-type for the winter gifting season, matching the explicit gift-guide exclusion rule, not genuine holiday-specific PLPs. 'Holiday Gift Guide - Hosts/Hygge/Kids/Staff Picks/Stocking Stuffers/Under $50', 'Holiday Guide: 12 Random Gifts', 'The Holiday Edit' - explicitly named gift guides, excluded per rules. 'Figurines & Ornaments' (/collections/figurines-ornaments, real qty 53) - inspected contents: Kay Bojesen wooden animal figurines, Vitra/Fritz Hansen miniature furniture, abstract sculptures (a couple of Santa figurines present among 53 items) - a general decorative-objects category that merely contains a few seasonal items, not itself a seasonal category (explicit boundary rule). 'Holiday Sale 2019', 'Exclusive Holiday Sale', 'Artemide/Muuto/Houe/Innovation/Skagerak/Woud Holiday Sale/Promo', 'Festive Dining Sale' - storewide/brand promotional sale pages, excluded per rules. Note: designpublic.com's homepage theme content/title/canonical unexpectedly renders as 'Shades of Light' branding (shared backend/parent-company infrastructure), but all /collections/* pages fetched directly on the designpublic.com domain render correctly with 'Design Public' branding and their own theme, confirming this is a live, independently addressable Design Public storefront and not a broken/redirected site.
